name: Altar of Damnation, Shadowmoon Valley
shortDescription: The Burning Crusade Shadowmoon Valley: a dark ritual platform among ash-black cliffs, burning fel-green fissures and a red, smoke-laden sky. The scene is original and not a dungeon plan.
